title: Add noninteractive scripted TUI mode for replay
purpose: Allow CI and release gates to drive the same TUI command path without an interactive terminal.
scope: Add a scripted TUI input mode that reads commands from a fixture file or stdin.
Emit deterministic text and JSON evidence outputs.
Use the same parser and controller as interactive mode.
Fail with nonzero exit on rejected required command or safety violation.
acceptance_criteria: Scripted mode and interactive mode share command parsing and dispatch.
Replay fixtures can assert command results and final snapshots.
Rejected unsafe commands fail closed with machine-readable evidence.
No terminal control library is required for baseline replay.
failure_modes: Scripted mode uses a separate parser from interactive mode.
Replay cannot distinguish expected rejections from unexpected failures.
Scripted mode bypasses approval token checks.
